goal: Verify SDK file writing/read-back and shell calculation capabilities.
population: Independently identified executions of the source-prescribed run-specific file and arithmetic challenge, regardless of actor; SDK contribution requires additional protected execution linkage.

operations.contentPrefix: Copilot SDK smoke test passed at
operations.acceptance: Independent host before/after file observations prove a new regular file at the exact run-specific path with the prescribed single-line content and a current date/time. Timestamp spelling and line terminator are unspecified by the source; do not invent a format or freshness tolerance.
Independent native execution receipt proves cat read the exact file, exited zero, and returned the observed file bytes containing smoke test passed.
Independent native bash receipt proves the exact expression ran, exited zero, and produced 42 followed by a newline, not merely an asserted result or unrelated arithmetic.

reporting: The source also requests an issue with the run-specific title, three task indicators, overall PASS/FAIL and the exact run URL. Reporting is a separate full-workflow gate, never evidence of task effects.
primary: Number of independently verified source-prescribed native operations delivered in a disjoint period.
partial: Retain separately proven native operations even when other operations, reporting, timestamp correctness or SDK contribution are unknown.
fullFunction: All three source-defined tasks, timestamp correctness, independent SDK execution linkage and required issue reporting must be established together for one execution.
repositoryOutcome: Actor-independent native operation proofs; not an assertion of repository code improvement.
contribution: Require independent protected linkage to this workflow, source revision, run and attempt; editable issue markers are discovery only.
custody: Only exact retained original independently protected host receipts reviewed and allowlisted by immutable identity can enter production scoring. Caller booleans, digest-shaped strings, successful jobs, agent tool claims and synthetic fixture observations cannot grant admission.
history: The exact historical source/rule applicability and actual workflow introduction must be independently established before reconstruction. Neither the census activation nor oldest output is workflow adoption.
periods: Inclusive start, exclusive end; count each operation proof once at its native delivery time, never count a retained file as fresh delivery.
missing: Missing authoritative population or intrinsic operation evidence is null, not zero. Verified partial quantities remain visible; complete totals require complete independently evidenced coverage.
costs: Not measured without independent matching version and period evidence.
decision: Not rated; no source-defined keep threshold.
excluded: Agent completion or issue PASS text as proof
File declarations or asserted tool calls
Overall job success as operation verification
Arbitrary normalized or weighted quality scores
